name: print-social-april-fools-flyer-black-holographic-wind-up-teeth
title: 'April Fool's Is Just Around The Corner' flyer with holographic wind-up chattering teeth on black
whatItIs: A black A5 flyer with a holographic gradient ribbon wave, a red wind-up chattering-teeth toy rendered in holographic texture, a blue wind-up key, holographic star and ring shapes, and bold white condensed 'APRIL FOOL'S IS JUST AROUND THE CORNER'.
whatItMeans: Playful and eye-catching; the holographic foil effect on a novelty toy makes a joke holiday feel like a premium event.
techniques: Render a novelty object in holographic gradient texture.
Set bold condensed type against pure black for contrast.
Use a wavy ribbon line to add movement across the layout.

vocabulary.definition: A shifting rainbow gradient mimicking foil or prism material.
A playful prop chosen for its comic association.
